resources.string: Every streaming, cloud, console, PC-game, emulator, media and library client Pocket Nexus works with or is evaluating, with what each one really does here.
A description only: nothing here signs in, installs or starts a game. Installed apps are found on this handheld; everything else is labelled as it is.
Pocket Nexus opens your installed app. Sign-in, purchases and settings stay in that app.
Pocket Nexus opens the official site. Sign-in and play stay with the provider.
Runs on your PC. Pocket Nexus connects to it from the handheld.
Being evaluated for Pocket Nexus. Nothing from it is included or available here yet.
Its canonical project has not been confirmed, so Pocket Nexus makes no claim about it.
Pocket Nexus runs this stream and sees its session.
The service manages sign-in, queues and play. Pocket Nexus only knows that it opened the service.
Pocket Nexus opens the app and cannot see whether a game is running.
What plays can appear in Pocket Nexus through Android\'s media controls when notification access is allowed.
No session runs through Pocket Nexus.
Quick Resume can return to a stream Pocket Nexus started.
Pocket Nexus does not resume it. Any resume is the client\'s own.
The built-in engine, derived from Moonlight and Artemis, streams from Vibepollo, Apollo or Sunshine on your PC.
Runs the service\'s own site full screen inside Pocket Nexus, in a separate process.
Optional. If a selected title has no supported link, the app opens without that title.
Read-only catalog from your own RomM server over verified HTTPS. No downloads or save sync.
Imports an Obtainium export and can check public stable release tags on GitHub.
Primary host. Nexus Host reads its local metadata with a scoped token.
Nexus Host can read an opt-in Playnite export. No launching from it yet.
Nexus Host uses a Ludusavi you provide for per-game Windows save snapshots and previews.
